verdicts.justification: hyp.save({'a':1}, f, protocol=5, banana='x') completed with 'no error; warnings: []' (warnings.catch_warnings(record=True)). Source verified: def save(obj, fname, **kwargs): docstring is the single sentence 'Pickle `obj` to `fname`.' and the body calls pickle.dump(obj, f) without forwarding kwargs -- so an explicitly passed protocol= is silently ignored. Upgraded from doc to minor because silently discarding a functional kwarg is behavioral, not just a docs gap.

Own Parameters-section parser over the live classes: DeepAutoencoder UNDOC [batch_size, device, epochs, lr, random_state, verbose]; ConvolutionalAutoencoder and VariationalAutoencoder identical; SequenceAutoencoder UNDOC [device, epochs, lr, random_state, verbose]; SparseAutoencoder UNDOC [batch_size, device, epochs, hidden_dims, lr, random_state, verbose]. Each subclass has its own docstring (so autodoc will not fall back to the base class doc), and per-class rst stubs exist under docs/ (hypertools.reduce.autoencoders.*.rst).
commands_run: .venv/bin/python custom Parameters parser over the 5 autoencoder subclasses (MPLBACKEND=Agg)
